sourceBoundary: Begins with Tales of Suspense #39 and ends with X-Men (2021) #26. It preserves all 815 whole-issue source occurrences from the twelve retained sections, of which two (Tony Stark: Iron Man (2018) #15 and #16) repeat a first occurrence read earlier in source order and two (Iron Man: Viva Las Vegas #3 and #4) were solicited but never published and are excluded as a closed source correction, leaving 811 distinct issues placed once each at their first retained occurrence.

sourceReview.rationale: Central review re-derived the exact 815-row source ledger from the committed evidence-boundary artifact and the live source page, reconciled all twelve retained sections, resolved all 811 canonical issues (including the owner-supplied exact ids for Crimson Dynamo #1-4 and Iron Man Legacy #2, #5, and #10, which this project's live metadata index does not currently list), recorded the two repeated Tony Stark: Iron Man (2018) #15/#16 occurrences, and recorded Iron Man: Viva Las Vegas #3-4 as a closed source correction rather than an unresolved gap.
